title: Projects for the whole team
summary: Share a project with your whole organization, and let coding agents propose routines.

highlights.title: Projects for your organization
highlights.body: Share a project with everyone in your organization. Teammates use the AI you chose for it, and you can revoke access at any time.

highlights.title: Routines from your coding agents
highlights.body: Claude, Codex, Hermes and Pi can propose routines from the terminal. You approve the exact action in Chat on any device.
